artworks.title: Landscape with a Castle and Radiating Sun
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with an elevated castle on a hill surrounded by dense trees. Mountain ranges can be seen in the background, with the sun shining from the right side, casting light and shadows across the scene. The illustration uses detailed line work and cross-hatching techniques, creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing contrast and shading. In the foreground, there are small buildings, trees, and a winding path leading towards the castle.

artworks.title: Saints Peter and Paul Seated in a Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows two men seated on a rocky surface. The man on the left holds a book in his left hand and rests his right hand on his lap. He wears a loose-fitting robe and is barefoot. Next to him is an object resembling a large knife. The man on the right points with one hand and holds an open book on his knee. He also wears a robe with billowing sleeves. In the background, a wooded area with a few trees is visible.

artworks.title: The Lamentation
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures in the foreground, with a full display of their bodies. The central figure is a lifeless male, reclining in the arms of individuals surrounding him. His head is cradled by a woman who kneels in front of him. The people around him are positioned in seated or kneeling stances, dressed in draped garments. Their facial features are detailed, conveying a sense of concentration or mourning. The background is a rocky landscape with a large wooden cross, and a cityscape in the distance. Various objects lie on the ground near the group, including a crown of thorns and nails.

artworks.title: The Rest on the Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene in a pastoral landscape. The image shows a group of figures gathered closely together. Some have wings and are holding a musical scroll. In the center, a robed figure with long hair holds a smaller figure. In the background, a rocky, mountainous landscape appears with a city or village visible under a lightly clouded sky. The linework defines the folds of the garments and the texture of the terrain in detailed and intricate ways.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.description: The image shows a Nativity scene with Mary holding baby Jesus. She is surrounded by three figures, likely the Magi, one kneeling and two standing. Another figure is standing to the side. The background includes an architectural structure with hills in the distance.

artworks.title: Peasant and Egg Woman
artworks.description: The image shows two figures depicted in a detailed etched style. The standing person holds a walking stick. They have curly hair, wear a cap, loose-fitting garment, tunic, leggings, and slip-on shoes. The seated person's face is partially covered by a wimple. They wear a long gown, and their hands appear to hold small round objects. Next to them is a basket filled with similar objects. The background features horizontal lines indicating a wooden or textured wall and a simple area suggesting steps or a platform.

artworks.title: Two Loves
artworks.description: This image shows two winged figures standing near a tree. The figures are positioned around a tree trunk, with one of them holding a seashell. In the background are smaller trees and a building under a clear sky. The drawing uses line work to create texture and depth, especially in the wings and tree bark.

artworks.title: Gardeuse d'oies nue (Nude Goose Girl)
artworks.description: The image displays the back view of a nude individual standing by a riverbank. The person is depicted from the head to the lower legs, standing upright with one arm raised, potentially against a tree or holding onto a draped cloth. The individual's facial features are obscured, and they have short, dark hair. The person is surrounded by trees, foliage, and ducks in the water nearby, contributing to a serene and natural environment. The background consists of more trees and plants, creating a lush outdoor atmosphere.

artworks.title: Wooded Landscape at L'Hermitage, Pontoise (Paysage sous bois, a L'Hermitage, Pontoise)
artworks.medium: aquatint, soft-ground, and drypoint on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The image shows a cluster of trees creating a lattice. In the background, there are structures, possibly cottages or farmhouses, and hills in the distance. The brushstrokes are loose and impressionistic, creating a soft, misty quality. The scene is in muted tones of grayscale, with varying shades from dark shadows to light highlights. In the foreground, there is rough-textured ground with foliage and a figure with their back turned. The background merges with the trees.

artworks.title: Whistler
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright with hands in the pockets of a long coat. They wear a tall hat, spectacles, and have a mustache. The background is plain and the person holds a writing instrument. The text "APE." is located in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: J.J. Rousseau
artworks.artist: Augustin de Saint-Aubin after Maurice-Quentin de La Tour
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man facing forward and slightly turned to his left. He has a smooth forehead, a well-defined nose, and slightly smiling lips. His hair is styled in a traditional 18th-century manner, with full, curly hair around his face. He is dressed in a formal jacket, buttoned-up vest, and a cravat. The background features an oval frame within a rectangular border, with an engraved nameplate below stating “J.J. ROUSSEAU.” The engraving is monochrome with detailed line work for shading and texture.

artworks.title: Frontispiece: Aidé de la sagesse, on se sauve de l'amour dans les bras de la raison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical scene with figures and architecture. The drawing depicts a group of figures in a classical setting, with a domed building supported by columns in the background. The foreground includes three central, draped figures in elegant flowing robes, one of whom wields a spear while the others look towards the sky or to the side in dynamic poses. These figures appear to interact with cherubic, winged creatures that float above them and around clouds. Surrounding the figures are detailed natural elements, including leaves and trees, and the sky is filled with stylized clouds. The scene appears to capture a narrative moment, often typical of classical allegorical or mythological themes, executed with detailed line work and shading.

artworks.title: Voilà la règle de la nature, pourquoi la contrariez-vous?
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior setting. The scene shows a richly decorated room with intricate drapery, a bed with luxurious fabrics, and a group engaged in leisurely activities. Children are present in the room, along with elegant furniture like chairs and a round table. Text in French below the image reads, "Voilà la règle de la nature, pourquoi la contrariez-vous?" which translates to "This is the rule of nature, why do you contravene it?" The interior design includes ornate wall paneling and decorative trims, typical of an 18th-century style.

artworks.title: Chacun respecte le travail des autres, afin que le sien soit en sûreté
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene with three individuals engaged in a rural activity. The drawing depicts a serene rural setting with lush foliage and a thatched-roof building in the background. A large tree dominates the center with detailed leaves providing a canopy. The foreground shows texture of the ground with clumps of earth and a shovel embedded in the soil. One individual is leaning on a shovel, another is pouring water from a container, and the third is observing or gesturing towards the others. The clothing style is indicative of a historical period, with knee-length breeches, hosiery, and brimmed hats. The scene conveys a sense of community and cooperation as suggested by the French inscription below.

artworks.title: Piqué de ma raillerie, il s'évertue et remporte le prix
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people outside a rustic house with a thatched roof. The scene is lively and animated, with a child and a dog playing in the foreground. Adults are engaged in conversation or a game. A large tree provides shade, and in the background, there are additional thatched roofs hinting at a small village. The figures express a sense of camaraderie and community. The drawing features detailed line work to depict textures and forms.

artworks.title: Courons vîte: l'astronomie est bonne à quelque chose
artworks.artist: Noël Le Mire after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with two figures, one seemingly assisting the other, possibly a child. The figures are depicted in an etching style with detailed line work and shading. In the background, there are trees, foliage, and distant rooftops, all rendered with depth and detail. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of black and white.

artworks.title: La nature étaloit à nos yeux toute sa magnificence
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: The image shows a shaded black and white scene with a point of view looking slightly upward towards two figures engaged in conversation. The figures are close to the viewer, partly shielded by a tall tree that frames the scene. The horizon is low, showing a mountain range in the distance, with peaks rising above the clouds. Further back, a landscape unfolds with rivers, trees, and a village nestled between undulating hills. The artwork features fine and delicate brushstrokes or etching lines, rendering detailed natural elements and clothing. The color palette is monochromatic, using variations of gray tones to create a serene yet dramatic atmosphere.

artworks.title: La barque
artworks.artist: Noël Le Mire after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a small boat in rough waters near a rocky shoreline. The boat is battling waves with turbulent waters splashing against its sides. There are towering cliffs or a mountainous backdrop on the left side of the image, and a large tree on the right. Clouds swirl across the sky above.

artworks.title: La confiance des belles âmes
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people engaged in a scene. A woman is being supported by a man, with another man reaching out towards her. The woman appears to be in a faint or swooning position, with her eyes closed and head tilted back. She is wearing a formal dress with a wide skirt, ruffles, and embellishments, along with a hat adorned with flowers. The supporting man has mid-length hair and is dressed in period clothing. Another man is next to a carriage, with a small dog in front of him. An older man on the right is dressed in formal attire and has his hand extended. A stone wall with an ornate gate and a large tree are in the background.

artworks.title: Sophie remettez-vous
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor dining scene. Four seated figures and one standing figure are gathered around a round table covered with a tablecloth. The composition suggests a formal gathering, perhaps a dinner party, with fine china and utensils placed on the table. There are shelves visible in the background with items. The drawing features detailed line work capturing the clothing and expressions of the figures. The room is depicted with visible wall paneling.

artworks.title: Les folâtres jeux sont les premiers cuisiniers du monde
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group picnic scene under lush trees. The drawing depicts a group enjoying a picnic on the grass, surrounded by towering trees with abundant foliage. The central focus is on a laid-out blanket with various picnic items. Bottles and a basket add to the communal atmosphere. Two figures in period costumes appear to be pouring drinks and engaging in interactions. The detailed etching style enhances the textures of the fabric, trees, and landscape, providing a glimpse into the pastime being enjoyed.

artworks.title: Un violent exercice étouffe les sentimens tendres
artworks.artist: Noël Le Mire after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures outdoors with a dog. They are in a rural scene, with one figure holding a long stick. The dog is playful. The background includes lush vegetation, a fence, trees, and clouds in the sky. The drawing style is detailed and linear. A caption below reads, "Un violent exercice étouffe les sentiments tendres," which translates to "Violent exercise stifles tender feelings".

artworks.title: Le Devin du Village (Colette Weeping)
artworks.artist: Pietro Antonio Martini after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with architecture and trees. The image depicts a detailed outdoor setting featuring a large tree with expansive branches framing the background on the left edge. Behind the tree, the silhouette of a church or large building with a pointed roof can be seen. To the right, a stone or brick house is partially visible, with foliage creeping up the walls. The intricate detailing of the architecture and nature, alongside the evident depth created by the overhanging branches and distant buildings, adds a sense of serene elegance to the landscape scene.

artworks.title: Il en est nâvre, je l'entraine avec peine
artworks.artist: Noël Le Mire after Jean-Michel Moreau
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a formal gathering. The image shows a group of individuals wearing elaborate 18th-century attire engaging in conversation. The background features classical architectural elements such as columns. The individuals are in a room with a high ceiling, with detailed clothing showcasing the fashion of the era. The drawing conveys drama and emotion, potentially capturing a narrative moment. The composition shows figures closely arranged together, suggesting intimacy and connection.
